svg.title: A line approaches a band
svg.desc: Three complete orbital drawings at a half-turn starting angle share one scale. Fourteen, sixty, then two hundred forty folds become finer within the same annulus, whose inner radius is 170 and outer radius is about 333.66. Every point in that annulus is within the printed distance of its smooth curve. The rigorous distances are upper bounds, not measured largest gaps. The sampled drawings have chord and rounding error below 0.01 sheet units. The finite curves are still lines; no crossing count or whole-branch clearance is asserted.

g.text: More folds. The same two radial edges.
One scale · lengths 245, 140, 65 · backward starting angle 180°
*Rounded up: guaranteed bounds, not measured largest gaps.
At 1,049 folds, every band point is within one drawing unit of the line.
The distance is measured to the ideal line, before adding ink thickness.
